title: Role of Interfacial Coherency on Creep Behavior of FCC/BCC High-Entropy Alloy Multilayers.

recollection.intervention: Study of interfacial coherency effects on creep behavior
recollection.structure: Multilayered FCC/BCC high-entropy alloy system with varying interfacial coherency
recollection.mechanism: Interfacial coherency likely influences dislocation motion and creep resistance
recollection.results: Possibly quantitative data on creep rates as a function of interfacial coherency, but specifics are unknown.

score.note: The recollection only restates the title-level comparison of FCC/BCC multilayers with differing interfacial coherency. It generically mentions dislocation motion but omits the specific coherent, semicoherent, and grain-boundary structures, proposed amorphization/diffusion mechanism, layer periods, stress exponents, creep displacements, and creep rates.
